messages:
sarah: Quick sync idea — we should add an "Effective Access" preview to the Console when editing roles. shows what routes, quotas, and routing policies a user actually gets after inheritance/overrides.

mike: love this. major ask from enterprise pilots. can we show per-route quotas, and which model variants they can hit? :+1:

priya: do we plan to compute this server-side or client-side? server-side is authoritative but could be heavy for big orgs.

alan: server-side. we already compute effective entitlements for audit logs. but need cache + invalidation on role/tenant changes. otherwise the preview will lag.

olivia: UX question — show a condensed summary first, then expand per-route. folks don't want a giant table by default.

mike: agreed. summary rows: allowed/denied, effective quota (tokens/min), routing tier (hosted/dedicated/private), and any fallback policies. expand to see per-route rules.

priya: API shape proposal: `GET /v1/tenants/:tid/effective-access?subject=:user&expand=routes` returns list of routes + effective quota + routingPolicyId. keep it paginated.

alan: caution: that endpoint needs to compute transitive role inheritance + group memberships + service-accounts. complexity = O(roles + groups). let's add a `since` param to allow caching and ETag for cheap checks.

rbac-bot: Note: role-change events already emit `role.updated` with affected_tenants array. Could hook an invalidation job.

sarah: good. UX also needs to highlight mismatches between expected and actual — e.g., if console role grants `create:model` but routing policy denies hosted access, show warning and suggested remedy.

olivia: include a one-click "simulate" button? lets SREs test what a user would get without changing policies.

mike: simulate should take optional args: subject, route, overrides. we can reuse the effective-access endpoint with POST /simulate for ephemeral evaluation. no writes.

priya: telemetry: we should log which previews are used, and capture when the preview reveals a surprising deny so we can tune docs and role templates. event names: `preview.open`, `preview.simulate`, `preview.surprise` (boolean).

alan: also capture preview costs if simulation computes route-level quotas (est. cost of calculation) so we can prioritize caching.

mike: rollout plan: feature-flag the preview per-tenant. start with internal+pilot tenants. add an opt-in checkbox in admin settings.

sarah: rollout UX: add a small beta badge and an inline survey after first use for pilots. gather whether it prevented a production misconfig.

olivia: edge cases — external SSO groups with thousands of members. for preview simulation, we should short-circuit by expanding group membership only when needed and show "approximate" when truncated.

priya: also think about delegation: service accounts can be bound to a subset of routes via `route_scopes`. simulation must honor that.

alan: security: ensure simulation API respects tenant boundaries and requires admin scope. no leakage across tenants. enforce on the API layer.

mike: small implementation note — the console will need a compact table component for per-route diffs (before vs after). re-use existing diff UI used in rollout pages.

sarah: one more: show provenance per permission (direct role, inherited from role X, via group Y, default deny). helps debugging.

olivia: agreed. color-coded chips for provenance + hover tooltip to show the chain.

priya: backlog items: API endpoint, invalidation job, caching with ETag, simulate POST, telemetry events, UI compact summary, expand details, provenance chips, truncation policy for large groups.

alan: I'll draft the API spec and caching invariants. want to avoid synchronous recompute for every UI open. will push a proposal this week.

sarah: thanks. can we get a quick mock from design for the summary/expand by EOD Friday?

olivia: yes — will drop a quick Figma link in thread when ready.

mike: tagging @priya for API review and @alan for infra sizing.

priya: will review once alan posts the draft.

rbac-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance for role-indexer tomorrow 02:00 UTC, may affect preview warm caches.

alan: noted — we'll avoid rollout during that window.

sarah: awesome, thanks team. follow-ups: alan to post API draft, olivia to post mock, priya to review API, mike to add feature-flag scaffolding.

mike: got it.

priya: 👍

olivia: :)

alan: posting API draft in #eng-platform in 2h.
